thread:
marta: quick heads-up — deploybot failed the preflight for the merge window, provider in module network/core bumped unexpectedly, holding the cutover.
deploybot: preflight-check: module network/core provider_version constraint mismatch (expected ~>4.12, found 4.13). plan aborted. logs: https://ci.redwood/plan/7890 :warning:
jon: ack. is this the module we pinned last sprint?
marta: yes, we pinned it to avoid the 4.13 kv-cache change. appears someone updated the upstream module in the vendor registry.
kevin: do we have a simple revert? pin the provider in the root terraformrc or update module pin?
samira: short-term: pin provider to 4.12 in root overrides and re-run plan. long-term: we should test 4.13 in a canary.
alex: agree with samira. for this release we need predictable latency, so pin + apply. who will run the apply?
marta: i'm +1 to pin. planning a staged apply: staging -> canary -> prod, 20s spacing.
jon: define rollback criteria before we touch prod: if >1% error rate on egress or latency p50 increases by >50ms in canary, rollback. document in release notes.
kevin: noted. also make a note to add a tfstate snapshot before apply: `terraform state pull > preapply-1766612345.tfstate`
samira: i'll own the staged apply. i'll update the release notes with the provider pin and the canary criteria.
alex: permissions: we need a temporary allow on the CI service account for `iam:UpdateRole` in the tenant that hosts the tgw. @marta can you request the grant?
marta: filing request to people-ops now. ETA 15m.
deploybot: deploybot: hold placed on merge branch `release/v1.9.0` until manual clear. reason: preflight failed.
jon: once people-ops grants the role, run plan in staging and paste the plan summary here. small change only (provider constraint), should be safe.
kevin: quick checklist: 1) pin provider (root override) 2) snapshot tfstate 3) plan in staging 4) canary apply (traffic shadow) 5) monitor metrics 6) prod apply if canary green.
samira: copying checklist to release doc. I'll post links to dashboards once canary starts.
alex: if canary fails, plan to rollback by restoring tfstate snapshot + revert override commit. confirmable?
marta: yes, we tested tfstate restore before. keep rollback PR ready.
jon: minor nit: tag the commit with `infra:provider-pin-1766612345` so we can fast-rollback.
samira: will open PR now. expected merge hold ~30m total.
kevin: FYI ops-runner will run the prod apply if canary is green. ops-runner has emergency rollback playbook.
deploybot: deploybot: release hold cleared? no — still blocked until manual approve from @marta or @jon.
marta: i'll approve once staging plan summary looks identical except provider constraint.
j on: (typo) jon: once approved i'll ACK the prod apply window.
kevin: thanks team. I'll watch the dashboards. :eyes:
